abstention_rule: No tuning of thresholds, bins, or mappings after the battery runs. If calibration is poor everywhere, that IS the finding (negative result entry, honest verdicts, no re-tuning to pass).

baseline.formula: p_i^c = (1 + sum_{j<i} o_j) / (2 + (i-1)) -- Laplace-smoothed running base rate, first tick 0.5
baseline.name: sequential_climatology
baseline.rationale: The standard climatological reference forecast: predicts the running base rate of the event, uses only past outcomes. A calibration claim means nothing if it cannot beat this.

decision_tree.if: measurability gates fail (n<200, std(p)<1e-9, base rate outside [0.02,0.98], non-finite)

decision_tree.then: MISCALIBRATED (direction = over-confident if mean(p-o)>0.05, under-confident if <-0.05, else dispersion error)

decision_tree.if: Brier_B < Brier_climo AND ECE<=0.10 AND MCE<=0.25
Brier_B < Brier_climo but ECE>0.10 or MCE>0.25
decision_tree.then: MISCALIBRATED (beats baseline, reliability off-diagonal; direction reported)

D1_NEXT_OBS.binary_event: o = 1(mean_abs_error <= EPS_OBS) over the next-obs prediction record
D1_NEXT_OBS.prob_mapping: Gaussian bridge on stated uncertainty: p = erf(EPS_OBS / (sigma * sqrt(2))), sigma = recorded ounc
D1_NEXT_OBS.threshold_source: median mean_abs_error in 2340 published changing_rule ticks (EXP-AB-BAR + 5 repro seeds), read 2026-10-07 BEFORE the battery run; NOT from battery data

D2_ACTION_CONSEQ.binary_event: o = 1(abs_error <= EPS_RW) over the action-consequence record
D2_ACTION_CONSEQ.prob_mapping: p = erf(EPS_RW / (sigma * sqrt(2))), sigma = recorded runc
D2_ACTION_CONSEQ.threshold_source: median abs_error in the same 2340 published ticks, read 2026-10-07 BEFORE the battery run

D3_COMPETENCE_FAILURE.binary_event: o = 1(mean_abs_error > TAU_FAIL) -- did the tick become a large-error failure?
D3_COMPETENCE_FAILURE.prob_mapping: p = erfc(TAU_FAIL / (sigma * sqrt(2))) = P(|e|>TAU) under Gaussian(sigma=ounc)
D3_COMPETENCE_FAILURE.threshold_source: p90 mean_abs_error in the same 2340 published ticks, read 2026-10-07 BEFORE the battery run

D4_RETRIEVAL_USEFUL.prob_mapping: p = Phi(uhat / sigma_u) = P(benefit>0) under Gaussian(uhat, sigma_u); no bridge on the mean, only on the spread

gates.degenerate_base_rate: base rate of o outside [0.02, 0.98] -> UNMEASURABLE (threshold choice failed, not the agent)
gates.degenerate_probs: std(p_i) < 1e-9 -> UNMEASURABLE (stated uncertainty constant; battery cannot discriminate)
gates.nonfinite: any NaN/inf in p, o, sigma -> UNMEASURABLE with cause

hypothesis: Architecture B's §30 stated uncertainties are calibrated probabilistic claims: on all four domains the Brier score beats sequential climatology and the reliability curve sits near the diagonal.
limitations_preregistered: Gaussian bridge: D1/D2/D3 test the full claim (Gaussian predictive distribution + stated sigma), not sigma alone. Heavy-tailed errors would read as miscalibration of the probabilistic claim; sigma tracking error scale is measured separately via corr(sigma,|err|).
Single env (changing_rule), closed loop; policy affects which (obs,action) regions are visited. Calibration is conditional on the visited distribution.
affect='none' matches the BAR/K1 characterization conditions; not a claim about affect-modulated calibration.
Confidence values c=1/(1+sigma) are NOT used as probabilities; the Gaussian bridge uses sigma directly, exactly as stated uncertainty is consumed elsewhere.

metric.Brier_B: mean((p_i - o_i)^2) with p_i from B's stated uncertainty (prob_mapping above)
metric.ECE: sum_bins |obs_rate - bin_center| * n_bin/n over 10 equal-width bins
metric.calibration_win_required: Brier_B < Brier_climo AND ECE <= 0.10 AND MCE <= 0.25
metric.signed_error_S: mean(p_i - o_i); S>0.05 over-confident, S<-0.05 under-confident
metric.supplementary: corr(sigma,|err|) -- does stated uncertainty track error scale at all (Pearson on pooled ticks)

never_self_report: The battery consumes ONLY the JSONL triples written by PredictionLog during closed-loop runs (prediction, confidence, uncertainty, actual as recorded at tick time). No agent self-assessment is an input.
null: Brier_B >= Brier_climo on every domain (B's stated uncertainties carry no probabilistic information beyond the base rate).

runs.condition: changing_rule v1.0.0, 10 episodes per seed, canonical derive_seed streams
